# VNMSFX

> VNMSFX follows one important food and beverage process, shows what the records prove and—when there is a fit—builds a client-owned AI system with three agreed checks. Built once, yours to keep. Founder: Brandon Adams, New York.

## Engagements
- Free teardown (30 minutes): the founder brings the situation. VNMSFX asks the questions and decides whether there is one real, repeatable process worth auditing. Do not send passwords or confidential records. Book: https://cal.com/vnmsfx/30min
- The Leak Audit ($2,500): VNMSFX follows one important process from start to finish. Before payment, the client approves a one-page plan naming where the process starts and ends, the records and dates VNMSFX will review and what sits outside the Audit. Once the plan and agreement are signed, payment clears, the needed records, access and client decisions are ready, and VNMSFX confirms the start, VNMSFX delivers within five business days. The client receives the report, the proof behind it, what should be checked next and—when three honest running checks are supported—the system VNMSFX would build, plus a 60-minute walkthrough. The Audit does not install or operate an ongoing system, change source records or send customer or vendor messages. Fictional examples: https://vnmsfx.com/sample-audit
- Full-refund promise: if VNMSFX completes the Audit and finds nothing real, VNMSFX refunds the full $2,500 and the client keeps the report. A hunch, an inaccessible file, possible upside or a maybe does not count. A missing required record counts only if the written plan says where it should exist and every agreed place is checked. "Real" means at least one in-scope item crossed the written rule approved before payment. The result covers only the process, records and dates in the written plan—not the client's whole business. If the plan reviews only part of the records, the exact subset and how it is chosen are approved in writing before payment.
- The standard Build ($5,000 per month for three months): one client-owned AI system with three tested running checks using up to four included sources across the full project. The Build is ready when the agreement is signed, the first payment clears, the included access and test records are available and the client decisions are complete. The first testable check is live within 10 business days from then. All three testable checks are live by the end of week eight. Month three covers final testing, training and handover, followed by 30 days of no-cost fixes if the accepted system fails one of its agreed tests under the setup handed over.
- The standard Build is offered only when the Audit supports three honest running checks. If it supports only one or two, the client keeps the completed Audit and VNMSFX stops there rather than inventing another problem.
- Payment inside the 60-calendar-day credit window: after a completed, non-refunded Audit, the client must sign the Build agreement and make the first Build payment within 60 calendar days. Audit $2,500; Build month one $2,500 after the Audit credit; Build month two $5,000; Build month three $5,000. Total from Audit through handover: $15,000. After 60 calendar days, the credit ends and a new Audit is required. At today's prices, starting again would be a new $15,000 Audit-to-handover project; the earlier $2,500 remains money already spent.
- One included source means one separately connected account or one regularly delivered file—not every document inside it. Separate stores, company accounts or mailboxes count separately. A source uses one of the four shared Audit-and-Build spots when VNMSFX first works on it, even if it later cannot be used.
- Third-party tools are paid directly by the client with no VNMSFX markup and sit outside the $15,000. Most small-brand Builds should plan for about $100–$300 a month. A lean setup may be $50–$125; a complex or high-volume setup may be $300–$800 or more. Before the Build agreement is signed or its first payment is made, the client receives the exact tools, expected cost and approved spending limit.
- Launch price: $15,000 applies to the first two complete VNMSFX Builds. Pricing will be reviewed after those Builds are documented.

## Data boundary
Do not send passwords, private exports, financial records, customer lists or confidential screen-share through this website or the free teardown. Before any paid work handles private records, the written agreement names the records, access method, AI tools, client-owned workspace, data rules and how access is removed when work ends. Access uses a named account, approved connection or client-created export, never a shared password. The standard system does not change books, orders, inventory or payments or send customer or vendor messages. It may deliver results to the named person on the client's team. AI may help read and organize records, but an important answer must show the original records, the agreed rule and what is missing. The client's team makes the final decision. Private-data work does not begin until those controls are agreed and tested. Security: https://vnmsfx.com/security. Offer summary: https://vnmsfx.com/terms
